# GeneralUser GS 2.0.3

Unmodified SoundFont by S. Christian Collins, distributed under
[LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt). Downloaded from
[mrbumpy409/GeneralUser-GS](https://github.com/mrbumpy409/GeneralUser-GS/tree/684543d5e5efaef08d02be50dcda8d552478fa60),
commit `684543d5e5efaef08d02be50dcda8d552478fa60`.

The upstream `GeneralUser-GS.sf2` is retained with its original name. SHA-256:
`9575028c7a1f589f5770fccc8cff2734566af40cd26ed836944e9a5152688cfe`.

Native builds and release archives copy it beside the executable as
`swc-music.sf2`. SWC's SDL music adapter uses it for General MIDI instruments;
it does not reproduce the original QuickTime/Roland instrument timbres.
`WC1_SWC_SOUNDFONT` can select another complete General MIDI SoundFont,
including the standard, jazz and orchestral percussion kits used by the demo.

Project website: https://www.schristiancollins.com/generaluser.php
